slug: 2025-04-11 Zambia commences nationwide mobile campaign for issuance of 3.5M ID documents

systems.owner: Registrar General, under the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: three-month campaign launched 10 April 2025 in Kitwe, all ten provinces, aimed at far-flung areas where national registration offices do not exist; target about 3.5 million citizens

note: An identity-card enrolment campaign; the article says nothing of the registration of births or deaths.
